name: Rental compliance
summary: Keeps rental compliance on track: reads open maintenance, tasks and current tenants, drafts internal follow-up tasks for jobs that stall, and queues any contractor booking for approval. Crons read and draft; a person approves every booking.

covered_by.safety-certificates: skill (reads the certificate and its date by hand)
covered_by.expiry-tracking: draft (follow-up tasks for stalled jobs); certificate expiry dates are not stored yet
covered_by.contractor-booking: approval (queued maintenance job, sent only when approved)
covered_by.record-keeping: draft (follow-up tasks and the snapshot kept in the store)

crons.name: watch
crons.summary: Read open maintenance jobs, open tasks and current tenants, and keep a snapshot. Writes nothing to VaultRE.

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: Draft one internal follow-up task for each open maintenance job that has been open for stale_days and has none yet.

crons.name: booking
crons.summary: Queue each new contractor booking request for approval (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia). Nothing is sent until a person approves it.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: reads, and an internal task for one VaultRE user. A maintenance job is live, because it creates a job that VaultRE can notify tenants and contractors about, so it only runs after approval.

vaultre.covers: open maintenance and tasks, follow-up tasks, contractor booking as a maintenance job

gaps: AgentBox is in the kit, but its 8 mapped operations cover contacts, properties and documents only. None covers compliance, maintenance or inspections.
Re-Leased is in the kit with inspection, maintenance and note operations, but it is built for commercial leases and its token exchange is not built. No adapter yet.

Console (Reapit PM) and PropertyMe: their vendor docs describe compliance reminders and inspection apps, but neither has a platform folder in the kit, so nothing can be mapped. PropertyMe's compliance reminders are the strongest lead for a later build.
Lease-start checklist and smoke alarm bookings: VaultRE has no compliance reminder or certificate operation. The agent checks these by hand.
Safety certificate and expiry dates: no mapped operation stores them, so expiry tracking uses VaultRE tasks only.
Tenant notices and breach escalation: VaultRE has no formal notice operation, and the docs do not describe legal notice forms.
Entry condition and routine inspections: the inspection operations need a tenancy path, and no cron reads them yet.
Owner reporting: no owner compliance report appears in the mapped operations.

Booking requests: nothing writes to the bookings collection yet, and no command exists to record one (the quoting workflow has a propose command; this one does not). The booking cron stays idle until a request is recorded. This needs a runtime change in core/, which was not made.

Unconfirmed against a live account: the addTask start format (ISO date-time, sent from the code) and the addMaintenance notifications field (sent empty, so no tenant notice is expected). The spec gives the field names only.
VaultRE status is spec. The tests run offline against a fake network and have not been run against a real account.
